title: Change.org petition 'NON à la mise sur écoute de votre téléphone avec Chat Control' launched
summary: French citizen Christophe Boutry launches a Change.org petition against Chat Control, which would automatically scan private messages, photos and emails including encrypted ones; it eventually gathers over 118,000 signatures.

title: CitizenGO petition 'Reject Chat Control! Stop EU Spying on Your Messages'
summary: Earlier CitizenGO English-language petition calling on citizens to reject Chat Control and EU spying on private messages. (Approximate 2025 launch; exact date and signature count not confirmed via the JS-rendered page.)

title: Signal calls on Germany to vote against Chat Control, threatens EU exit
summary: Signal President Meredith Whittaker publishes an open appeal urging Germany to reject Chat Control, warning that if forced to undermine encryption Signal would leave the EU market rather than comply.

title: Reality Check: EU Council Chat Control vote is a green light for mass surveillance
summary: After COREPER endorses a Council negotiating mandate, Breyer warns that Chat Control 'is not dead, it is just being privatized' — the text incentivizes voluntary mass scanning and mandatory age verification for all users.

title: Civil society open letter: 'We say no to Big Tech mass snooping on our messages'
summary: EDRi and dozens of civil society organisations publish an open letter urging the European Parliament to reject the second extension of the interim ePrivacy derogation ('Chat Control 1.0') that allows voluntary message scanning.

title: Historic vote: EU Parliament ends untargeted mass scanning of private chats
summary: Breyer hails a 'sensational victory' as the European Parliament narrowly (307-306) rejects extending the interim scanning regime, letting it expire on 4 April 2026 and limiting any scanning to judicially suspected individuals.

title: Petition update: 'Victoire ! Chat Control est officiellement enterré'
summary: L'organisateur de la pétition française annonce la victoire après le rejet de Chat Control par le Parlement européen le 26 mars 2026, fruit de mois de mobilisation citoyenne.

title: 'Double Threat' sparks relaunch of fightchatcontrol.eu
summary: Breyer relaunches the campaign platform fightchatcontrol.eu warning of a 'double attack': an attempt to revive Chat Control 1.0 and imminent concessions in the Chat Control 2.0 trilogue (29 June 2026), enabling citizens to email lawmakers.

title: fightchatcontrol.eu campaign tool relaunched
summary: The fightchatcontrol.eu action platform is updated to let EU citizens directly email MEPs and government representatives with a template summarising the legal and technical flaws of Chat Control 1.0 and 2.0.

title: Procedural trick before summer recess pushes EU Parliament toward capitulation on Chat Control
summary: Breyer denounces an EPP/Council-backed urgency procedure to revive the expired 'Chat Control 1.0' voluntary scanning regime, providing citizens a tool to lobby MEPs before the July 2026 votes.

title: CitizenGO petition 'Nein zur Chatkontrolle – Stoppt den Überrumpelungsversuch!'
summary: German-language CitizenGO petition mobilising against the last-minute July 2026 procedural attempt to reinstate Chat Control mass scanning of private messages. (Exact launch date and signature count not confirmed via the JS-rendered page.)

title: CitizenGO petition 'No to Chat Control'
summary: English-language CitizenGO petition urging citizens to oppose the reintroduction of Chat Control mass surveillance of private communications during the July 2026 votes. (Exact launch date/signature count not confirmed via the JS-rendered page.)

title: CitizenGO Facebook: 'URGENT: European Parliament has voted to approve Chat Control by a narrow margin'
summary: CitizenGO's alarmist Facebook post refers to the 7 July 2026 vote in which the Parliament approved (by roughly 331-304) the urgent procedure to fast-track revival of expired Chat Control 1.0 scanning rules — a procedural step, not final adoption, setting up the decisive 9-10 July vote.

title: Udruga Hrvatski ratnik: 'Ne kontroli razgovora (Chat Control) – Zaustavite pokušaj prepada!'
summary: Udruga Hrvatski ratnik poziva građane da potpišu peticiju protiv Chat Controla, upozoravajući da bi automatska analiza privatnih poruka dovela do lažnih uzbuna i zloupotrebe vlasti; poveznica vodi na CitizenGO peticiju.

title: Petition update: 'Chat Control revient : vote décisif au Parlement européen ce jeudi 9 juillet'
summary: La pétition française est relancée, alertant que le Conseil de l'UE tente de ressusciter Chat Control 1.0 via un règlement quasi identique et appelant à mobiliser avant le vote décisif du Parlement européen le 9 juillet 2026.
